records.source: 太陽の光さえ封じ込める黒色{j}の防具。装飾の隙間から誰か{j}に監視されているような気に。
records.previous: Black{j}armor that seals away even the sunlight. Through the gaps in its ornamentation, you feel as though{j}someone is watching you.
records.target: Black{j}armor sealing sunlight. Gaps in its{j}ornamentation make you feel watched.

records.source: 稲妻のように天を駆ける銀の{j}竜が命を吹き込んだ腕用装備。{j}振るう剣の切先も鋭さを増す。
records.previous: Silver that races across the sky like lightning{j}Arms equipment into which a dragon breathed life.{j}The edge of the sword you swing grows even sharper.
records.target: Silver arm gear, dragon-infused.{j}Its swung sword edge grows sharper.{j}

records.source: 工房の職人が技術の粋をつぎ{j}込んで作成した霞龍の腕装備。{j}ゆったりとして機能性に富む。
records.previous: Chameleos arms armor,{j}crafted by a workshop artisan who poured in the very finest skill.{j}Loose-fitting and highly functional.
records.target: Chameleos arm armor.{j}Made with the Workshop's finest skill.{j}Loose-fitting and highly functional.

records.source: 塔に君臨する女王を従えた証。{j}特殊な加工で現れた深き青が、{j}見る者の心を魅了する。
records.previous: Proof of having made the queen who reigns over the tower your servant.{j}The deep blue drawn out by special processing{j}captivates the hearts of all who behold it.
records.target: Proof of subduing the tower queen.{j}Special processing reveals deep blue that{j}captivates all who behold it.

records.source: 炎妃龍の素材を特殊な技術で{j}練り上げた腕用装備。身につ{j}けた者の心奥に青き炎が灯る。
records.previous: Arm equipment{j}crafted from Lunastra materials with special techniques. A blue flame burns deep in the heart of the{j}wearer.
records.target: Arm gear crafted from Lunastra materials.{j}A blue flame burns deep in the wearer's{j}heart.

records.source: 炎を律する王を従えた証。{j}最新の加工で現れた猛き赤が、{j}見る者の心を駆り立てる。
records.previous: Proof of subjugating the king who rules flames.{j}The fierce red that emerged from the latest processing,{j}stirs the hearts of all who see it.
records.target: Proof of subjugating the flame king.{j}Latest processing reveals fierce red that{j}stirs every viewer's heart.

records.source: 金獅子の良質の黒毛のみを最{j}新の技術で織り込んだ腕装備。{j}その腕は闇にとけ込む。
records.previous: Arms armor woven from only the finest black fur of the Gold Lion{j}with the latest techniques.{j}Those arms melt into the darkness.
records.target: Arm armor woven from finest Gold Lion fur{j}with modern techniques. It melts into{j}darkness.

records.source: 偉大な古龍をも打ち砕く力を{j}秘めた腕防具。古の時を生き{j}た古龍も恐れおののくという。
records.previous: Arm armor{j}concealing the power to shatter even{j}great Elder Dragons. Even Elder Dragons that lived in ancient times are said to tremble before it.
records.target: Arm{j}armor with power to shatter Elder Dragons.{j}Ancient Elder Dragons tremble before it.

records.source: 安らぎに満ちた冥暗の腕防具。{j}これを得た者には安息を与え、{j}進化させるという噂がある。
records.previous: Arm Armor of gloom filled with tranquility.{j}It is said to grant repose to those who obtain it, and{j}to cause them to evolve.
records.target: Arm armor of tranquil gloom.{j}Said to grant repose to its bearer and{j}cause them to evolve.

records.source: 遠方の工房より伝来した腕用{j}装備。断熱性に優れた特殊な{j}素材が使用され汎用性が高い。
records.previous: {j}armor for the Arms passed down from a distant workshop. Uses a special{j}material with excellent insulation, making it highly versatile.
records.target: {j}Arm gear from a distant workshop.{j}Insulating material makes it versatile.
